hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik ibn Aws ibn al-Hadathan al-Nasri: He sought to exchange one hundred dinars. He said: Talha ibn Ubaydullah called me and we negotiated until he exchanged with me and took the gold, turning it over in his hand. Then he said: 'Wait until my treasurer comes from al-Ghaba.' Umar ibn al-Khattab was listening, so Umar said: 'By Allah, do not part from him until you take it from him.' Then he said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Gold for gold is riba except hand to hand, wheat for wheat is riba except hand to hand, dates for dates is riba except hand to hand, and barley for barley is riba except hand to hand.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنَّ حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا أَمَرَ بِهِ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ لِلنَّاسِ ، فَبَاعَ حَكِيمٌ الطَّعَامَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْتَوْفِيَهُ ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ، فَرَدَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ، وَقَالَ : " لَا تَبِعْ طَعَامًا ابْتَعْتَهُ حَتَّى تَسْتَوْفِيَهُ "

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik that it reached him: Receipts were issued to people in the time of Marwan ibn al-Hakam for food from the public storehouse, and people traded those receipts among themselves before receiving the food. Zayd ibn Thabit and another man from the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon Marwan ibn al-Hakam and said: 'Are you permitting the sale of riba, O Marwan?' He said: 'I seek refuge with Allah, what is that?' They said: 'These receipts that people are trading among themselves before they receive the food.'

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik that it reached him: A man wanted to buy food from another man on credit. The man who wanted to sell him the food took him to the marketplace and began showing him the piles of food, saying to him: 'Which of these would you like me to buy for you?' The buyer said: 'Are you selling me what you do not have?' They came to Abdullah ibn Umar and mentioned that to him. Abdullah ibn Umar said to the buyer: 'Do not buy from him what he does not have.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْتَاعَ طَعَامًا مِنْ رَجُلٍ إِلَى أَجَلٍ ، فَذَهَبَ بِهِ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَبِيعَهُ الطَّعَامَ إِلَى السُّوقِ ، فَجَعَلَ يُرِيهِ الصُّبَرَ ، وَيَقُولُ لَهُ : مِنْ أَيِّهَا تُحِبُّ أَنْ أَبْتَاعَ لَكَ ؟

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id: He heard Jamil ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Mu'adhdhin saying to Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: 'I am a man who buys from the rations that are given to people at al-Jar whatever Allah wills, then I want to sell the guaranteed food on credit.' Sa'id said to him: 'Do you intend to fulfill from those rations that you bought?' He said: 'Yes.' So he forbade him from that.

Topics: Dialogue about selling rations before taking possession
Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab's ruling on food sales on credit
hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَمِيلَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُؤَذِّنَ ، يَقُولُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ : إِنِّي رَجُلٌ أَبْتَاعُ مِنَ الْأَرْزَاقِ الَّتِي تُعْطَى النَّاسُ بِالْجَارِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ، ثُمَّ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَبِيعَ الطَّعَامَ الْمَضْمُونَ عَلَيَّ إِلَى أَجَلٍ
